# Today component library

> Interactive Today UI components with readable browser code and supplied SwiftUI source. Public source, no authentication required.

## Start here
- [Repository](https://github.com/tltoan/today-components): clone or browse every file.
- [Agent guide](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/AGENTS.md): constraints, approved motion, and verification.
- [README](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/README.md): inventory, API details, and source status.
- [Component manifest](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components.json): machine-readable source and dependency mapping.

## Reusing components
- [Integration guide](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/INTEGRATION.md): copy reusable code, load dependencies in order, and distinguish SwiftUI from browser components.
- Each entry in components.json now includes browserIntegration and a sourcePage anchor. Scripts such as component-studies.js and welcome-study.js mount demos; do not import them into a product page.

## Components
- Dropdown/disclosure motion: [motion.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/foundations/motion.css), [disclosure.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/foundations/disclosure.js), [TodayMotion.swift](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/native/TodayMotion.swift). Approved shared 600 ms motion.
- Selection dropdown: [dropdown.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/dropdown.js), [dropdown.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/dropdown.css). Reusable browser selection control.
- Reading schedule: [index.html](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/index.html), [app.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/app.js), [style.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/style.css). Browser specimen.
- A space in your day: [snap-scroller.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/snap-scroller.js), [app.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/app.js), [style.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/style.css). Browser one-day snapping controller.
- Slide to log: [app.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/app.js), [style.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/style.css). Browser specimen; linked with checklist example state.
- Daily checklist: [app.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/app.js), [style.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/style.css). Browser specimen with synthetic data.
- Today logo: [today-logo.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/today-logo.js), [TodayLogoAnimation.swift](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/native/TodayLogoAnimation.swift). Browser component and unchanged supplied SwiftUI.
- Welcome landing: [welcome-intro.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/welcome-intro.js), [welcome-intro.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/welcome-intro.css), [welcome-study.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/welcome-study.js), [TodayWelcomeIntro.swift](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/native/TodayWelcomeIntro.swift), [TodayIntro.swift](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/native/TodayIntro.swift). Motion-only opening with logo, question, and gradient. Library follows below; original native source is preserved.
- Center cradle navigation: [bottom-nav.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/bottom-nav.js), [bottom-nav.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/bottom-nav.css), [cradle-fluid.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/cradle-fluid.js), [navigation-study.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/navigation-study.js). Selected shape. Plus is disconnected from the editor.
- Adaptive plan button: [plan-button.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/plan-button.js), [plan-button.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/plan-button.css), [component-studies.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/component-studies.js). Standalone state-controlled button with letter transitions.
- Page counter: [page-counter.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/page-counter.js), [page-counter.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/page-counter.css), [component-studies.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/component-studies.js), [AnimatedPageCounter.swift](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/native/AnimatedPageCounter.swift). Tap/hold counter with sequential one-page marks.
- Staggered bar chart: [staggered-bar-chart.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/staggered-bar-chart.js), [staggered-bar-chart.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/staggered-bar-chart.css), [component-studies.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/component-studies.js), [StaggeredBarChart.swift](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/native/StaggeredBarChart.swift). Synthetic dated chart; zero and no log are distinct.
- Retained New habit editor: [habit-editor.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/habit-editor.js), [habit-editor.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/habit-editor.css), [plan-readiness.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/plan-readiness.js). Retained source, not mounted. Sample English readiness rules; no AI or plan persistence.

## Scope
Browser previews use synthetic data and keep state in the page session. Native files are reusable source, not proof of app integration. No backend or private app repository is required. All URLs above are direct source paths, not compiled bundles.

## New collections
- Step progress indicator (Active Pill selected): [step-progress.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/step-progress.js), [step-progress.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/step-progress.css), [step-progress-study.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/step-progress-study.js). Set current, total (1–12), variant (segments, pill, rail, numbers, ring), and optional label attributes. This is presentation only, not navigation.
- Habit widgets: [widget-primitives.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/widget-primitives.js), [habit-widget.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/habit-widget.js), [habit-widget.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/habit-widget.css), [WIDGETS.md](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/WIDGETS.md). Assign model and an async save handler. Variants: small, medium, list, portraits, streak, lock, circular, lock-streak, summary, message. Read WIDGETS.md for all states, data semantics, action events and the full Figma coverage map.
- Habit calendar: [widget-primitives.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/widget-primitives.js), [habit-insights.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/habit-insights.js), [habit-widget.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/habit-widget.css), [habit-insights.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/habit-insights.css). Assign model with year, month, today, selected, entries, target, unit, rule and mode (activity/completion). Provide saved per-date target/rule and eligibility when history varies. See WIDGETS.md.
- Streak hero: [widget-primitives.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/widget-primitives.js), [habit-insights.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/habit-insights.js), [habit-insights.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/habit-insights.css). Assign model {count, label, through}. Confirmed streak calculation belongs to the host.
- Recent habit log: [widget-primitives.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/widget-primitives.js), [habit-insights.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/habit-insights.js), [habit-insights.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/habit-insights.css). Assign model {label, amount, unit, mark, date}. Route the log-open event using its supplied data.
- Warm Ember streak flame (selected): [streak-flame-art.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/streak-flame-art.js), [streak-flame.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/streak-flame.js), [streak-flame.css](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/components/streak-flame.css), [export-streak-assets.js](https://tltoan.github.io/today-components/scripts/export-streak-assets.js). Use the selected ember palette; other palettes are historical options. Call play() for a confirmed streak increase; still() cancels. One-shot 1.6 second motion settles to the still. SVG downloads live in assets/streaks/.

- Selected on November 20, 2026: Active Pill step progress and Warm Ember streak artwork. Widget source and WIDGETS.md include the refined spacing and interruptible liquid-fill controller.
